cohort: The study included 26,957 very low birth weight infants (9,758 multiples and 17,199 singletons) registered in a national Spanish network across 62 neonatal units from 2002 to 2013.
finding: At hospital discharge, multiple infants had a lower rate of exclusive breastfeeding (24%) compared to singletons (31%), and twin pregnancy was independently associated with a small but significant increased risk of breastfeeding cessation before discharge.
